sloka: तं पुरस्तात् स्थितं दृष्ट्वा वानरं पर्वतोपमम्।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो गदया वज्रकल्पया ।। ६.७०.५६ ।।
transliteration: taṁ purastāt sthitaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānaraṁ parvatopamam।ājaghānorasi kruddho gadayā vajrakalpayā ।। 6.70.56 ।।

translations.english: Again, seeing Rshaba standing in front like a mountain, enraged Mahaparsva hit him on the chest with the mace that was like a thunderbolt.
